visualScope: Burgos Cathedral with its twin openwork spires, Santa María rose and portal, octagonal crossing lantern, Sarmental front, Constable Chapel, and open cloister.
limitations: The model uses the mapped cathedral and ordinary exterior photographs. Vertical profiles, tracery, sculptures and small masonry details are visual approximations.
The cloister court remains open. The closed portals represent the exterior only, and surrounding plazas, the fountain and adjacent buildings remain in the host map.
